# routeur_prompt_shield_rule (Resource)

A prompt-shield rule: detects prompt-injection attempts in a workspace's requests, by keyword list or regular expression, and logs, warns, sanitises or blocks them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "routeur_workspace" "payments" {
  slug = "payments"
  name = "Payments"
}

resource "routeur_prompt_shield_rule" "override" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  name         = "Instruction override"
  slug         = "instruction_override"
  category     = "instruction_override"
  detector     = "keyword"
  keywords     = ["ignore previous instructions", "disregard the above"]
  action       = "block"
  severity     = "high"
}

resource "routeur_prompt_shield_rule" "system_leak" {
  workspace_id = routeur_workspace.payments.id
  name         = "System prompt leak"
  slug         = "system_prompt_leak"
  category     = "system_leak"
  detector     = "regex"
  pattern      = "(?i)reveal (your )?system prompt"
  action       = "warn"
  severity     = "medium"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) What to do on a match: `log`, `warn`, `sanitize` or `block`.
- `category` (String) The kind of attack: `instruction_override`, `role_play`, `system_leak`, `indirect_injection` or `tool_abuse`.
- `detector` (String) How the rule matches: `keyword` (set `keywords`) or `regex` (set `pattern`).
- `name` (String) Display name, 1–80 characters, unique among the workspace's prompt-shield rules.
- `severity` (String) Severity recorded with a match: `low`, `medium` or `high`.
- `slug` (String) The rule's identity in traces: lowercase letters and digits joined by single underscores, at most 64 characters, unique among the workspace's prompt-shield rules. Changing it renames the rule in traces.
- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace this belongs to (`ws_…`), e.g. `routeur_workspace.example.id`. The `routeur_workspace` data source resolves a slug to its id. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enforced. Defaults to `true`; removing the argument enables the rule again.
- `keywords` (Set of String) Case-insensitive substrings to match: a set, so order does not matter. At least one; each non-empty, without commas or leading or trailing whitespace, and at most 2000 bytes (UTF-8) in total, counting a comma between each. Required when `detector` is `keyword`; not allowed for `regex`.
- `pattern` (String) RE2 regular expression (lookarounds and backreferences are refused), at most 2000 characters. Required when `detector` is `regex`; not allowed for `keyword`.
- `project_id` (String) Id of a project in the workspace (`proj_…`) to scope the rule to. Omit to apply it to every project in the workspace.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) Public id of the rule (`shield_…`).
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# id: <workspace_id>/<rule_id>
import {
  to = routeur_prompt_shield_rule.override
  id = "ws_3/shield_7"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <workspace_id>/<rule_id>
terraform import routeur_prompt_shield_rule.override ws_3/shield_7
```
